phase: Development protocol fixed before real-cell validation
source: Reuse audited single-level MixedEffectsGP RBF/Matern and exact original source-budget encoders; no additional source labels or GP refit
inner_support: First10 only. Train labels0:t, predict t for t=5..9. Feature reference uses all first10 allowed curves, so this is inner-support prediction,not an online causal forecasting experiment.
mixing: Minimize sum of five squared inner predictive errors plus lambda*(private_weight-0.5)^2 over [0,1]. Lambda=5*source_GP_WhiteKernel_variance*source_y_scale^2, fixed multiplier1; no tuning of inner split or penalty.
final_adaptation: Both shared and private target posteriors use all first10 permitted labels; same selected weight for every later query of this cell, no query label or future-input weight update
selection: Each family independently selected by original B123 validation domain-equal MAE, ties lower gain then key. Same fold choice all8parents. Freeze all21folds before outer query scoring.
controls: Uniform0.5 must reproduce audited previous uniform predictions and selections. Report both families including no-gain choices and all failures.
acceptance: Independent and full incremental all3datasets all3metrics, full16 complementarity, paired uncertainty, fixed-GP source-risk sensitivity and mechanism controls before adoption
limits: Five inner points may be noisy and unrepresentative of later degradation
Source noise scale is a fixed regularizer,not a calibrated target uncertainty estimate
Predictive convex mixing and GP conditioning are standard operations,not claimed basic inventions
